content: Aftershave is a product that comes in the form of a lotion, gel, or liquid, primarily used by men after completing the act of shaving. It often contains an antiseptic agent, such as alcohol, which serves to prevent infections that may arise from small cuts sustained during shaving. Additionally, it can numb damaged skin, providing a soothing effect. Many aftershaves also include a fragrance to enhance the scent and a moisturizer to soften the skin. An alcohol-based, fragrance-free astringent can also function as an aftershave. The alcohol in such products is believed to close the pores of the skin and reduce irritation, commonly referred to as razor burn. However, aftershaves are sometimes mistakenly identified as Eau de Cologne, which is a different type of product. Prominent brands of aftershave include Brut, Global Gillette, Lynx, Adidas, Crabtree & Evelyn, and Old Spice. Furthermore, many fashion designer houses have extended their branding to aftershave products, including names such as Hugo Boss, Comme des Garçons, Tommy Hilfiger, Marc Jacobs, Calvin Klein, Lacoste, Jil Sander, and Vera Wang. Historically, substances resembling aftershave were used in ancient Egypt. These were applied to cleanse and deodorize a deceased body before it was treated with natron and wrapped in linen bandages as part of the mummification process.
